Its western part is commonly referred to as the High Desert, in contrast to the Low Desert near the ► Coachella Valley. The "Inland Empire" is separated from this desert by the San Bernardino Mountains, which lie east of the San Gabriel Mountains. Joshua trees are endemic to this desert, whose lowest point is at Badwater Basin in Death Valley. For 10 points, name this Southern California desert northeast of Los Angeles.
